tr: What's the first letter in "bayt"? / Bāʾ, with one dot below.
Is "ḥāl" spelled with ḥāʾ or with hāʾ? / With ḥāʾ, from the throat.
Is "ṣayf" spelled with sīn? / No, with ṣād.
What is "the language of ḍād"? / It's Arabic.
Is "qalb" spelled with kāf? / No, with qāf.
What's the last letter in "ʿarabī"? / Yāʾ.
Here you go, this is Arabic coffee. / Thanks.
Who's this? / This is Sara, she's a teacher.
It's hot today. / Yes, the sun is strong.
Do you have a dog? / Yes, I have a little dog.
What's this? / It's a camel.
Where did Ahmad study? / He studied in Cairo.
Hello. / Hello, welcome.
Hi Sara, how are you? / Fine, thank God. And you?
Good morning, sir. / Good morning.
Thank you very much. / You're welcome.
This is my friend Maryam. / Nice to meet you, Maryam.
Bye, Khalid. / Bye, see you later.
What's your name? / My name is Yusuf. And you?
Where are you from, Emily? / I'm from Chicago, but I live in Texas.
Where do you live, Karim? / I live in New York.
What do you do? / I'm an engineer; I work for a company.
How old are you? / I'm twenty-five.
Who's this? / This is my mom.
Do you have brothers and sisters? / Yes, I have a brother and a sister.
Where's your husband? / My husband is at work.
Who's this? / This is my friend John; he's American.
How much is this? / Fifty riyals.
What's the price? / Twenty dirhams.
Do you have a brother? / Yes, one brother.
What would you like? / I'd like Arabic coffee, please.
The check, please. / Here you go: fifty riyals.
How's the falafel? / Really delicious!
I'm really hungry. / Me too. Let's go to the restaurant.
Do you have a car? / Yes, I have a small car.
This is my new apartment. / The apartment is really nice!
Do you have a pen? / Yes, here you go.
Where's the key? / It's on the table in the kitchen.
What's the weather like in Amman? / The weather is nice today.
Where's Sara? / She's busy right now.
Is Arabic hard? / No, Arabic isn't hard!
This shirt is cheap. / Yes, and it's nice too.
Do you like coffee? / Yes, I drink coffee every day.
Where do you work? / I work in an office downtown.
What are you studying, Layla? / I'm studying medicine at the university.
When do you get up? / I get up early, at six.
What did you do yesterday? / I went to the movies with my friend.
What day is it today? / Today is Thursday.
Are you working tomorrow? / No, tomorrow is Saturday.
Where's Maryam? / She went to Amman last week.
Excuse me, where's the restaurant? / On the right, next to the hotel.
Where's the pharmacy? / Straight ahead, then on the left.
Is the museum near here? / Yes, it's very close.
The bank is in front of the mosque. / Sorry, I don't understand.
Your passport, please. / Here you are.
Do you speak English? / Yes, a little.
Good evening, I have a reservation. / Welcome! What's your name?
How much is the ticket to Alexandria? / Fifty pounds.
Where's the hotel? / Over there, next to the bank.
What are you doing now? / I'm reading the newspaper.
When is the lesson? / The lesson is tomorrow morning.
How do you get to the university? / By bus.
Who's this? / This is my brother Yusuf.
Hi Karim! How's the family? / Fine, thanks.
Thanks for the coffee! / You're welcome.
See you tomorrow? / Hopefully.
Here you are, this is your coffee. / Thank you very much.
Where's the train station? / Sorry, I don't know.
Bless your hands, the food is delicious. / Enjoy it, to your health!
This hummus is wonderful! / Enjoy it, to your health.
May your table always be full, auntie. / Thank you, son, you're always welcome.
Your Arabic is excellent! / Thanks, I'm still learning.
Where did you learn Arabic? / At university, in America.
I spoke Arabic at the restaurant! / Well done!
God give you strength, Ahmad. / And you too.
God give you strength, Mom. / And you too, son.
This is my son Yusuf. / God bless him! May God keep him safe.
You have a lovely home. / Thank you, you're welcome here.
You're so funny, Omar! / Thanks, so are you.
You're the best engineer in the company. / You're just being nice!
Looking fresh! / Thanks (God bless you too).
I helped you because you're my friend. / You're so kind, thank you.
You look beautiful tonight. / Thanks, and you look sharp.
You have a lovely smile. / Thanks, you're sweet.
Why are you laughing? / You always make me laugh!
Would you have a coffee with me? / With pleasure! When?
Will you come with us to the restaurant? / With pleasure.
Are you busy on Friday? / No, why?
Can we meet again? / Yes, I'd like that.
I have something to tell you: I like you. / Really? I like you too.
I really like you. / Thank you, you're a good person, but I'd rather we stay friends.
Would you have a coffee with me on Saturday? / Thanks, but I'm seeing someone.
You have really beautiful eyes. / You say that to all the girls!
God bless you, you look wonderful. / God keep you.
God bless you, you look sharp today. / Thank you, God bless you.
I missed you! / Me too. How was your trip?
I love talking with you. / Me too, you're really charming.
Shall we go to the restaurant tonight? / Maybe another time, I'm tired.
Why do you want to meet my father? / Because my intentions are serious.
Can we talk for a bit? / Sorry, I'm not interested.
How do I look? / You look very handsome today.
You have great taste! / Thanks, I bought this bag yesterday.
You have a sweet spirit. / And you say such sweet things!
Why not? Just once! / I said no. Please stop.
Are you busy tonight? / Yes, I'm married.
Did you understand the lesson? / Ah, now I get it!
What happened? / Ouch! My hand!
The train is an hour late. / Ugh!
This is my new house. / Wow! It's really beautiful.
I have a new job! / Really? I'm so happy!
I ran into my old teacher in London! / Amazing! It's a small world.
My grandmother is sick. / Oh, I'm sorry! May God keep her safe.
Congratulations on the new job! / Thank you (God bless you).
Ahmad went to Japan yesterday. / No way! He didn't say anything!
Come on, we're late! / One minute!
I'm leaving now. / Wait! You forgot the key.
Sara isn't at work today. / How strange! She's there every day.
I'm going to Cairo tomorrow for work. / Good luck!
Hopefully the weather will be nice tomorrow. / Please God!
My car isn't here! / Oh my God! Shall we call the police?
Hello, who's this? / It's Khalid.
I want another cup of coffee! / That's enough! You've had a lot today.
Watch out! The car! / Thanks, I didn't see it.
Help! / What happened? Are you OK? (to a woman)
God keep you safe. (to a man) / Amen, and you too. (to a woman)
